versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Clarified workflow for creating hanzi card sets from user-supplied character lists.
- Enforced accurate pack planning: do not invent or look up missing character details.
- Formalized input requirements, card grouping logic, and maximum card count (4–8).
- Outlined approval and billing steps before image generation using Beatra tools.
- Added recovery procedures and guidance for card review, correction, and delivery.
- Detailed secure, automatic update behavior for the bundled client.
